```release-note
Support spill of hash join v2
```

review_comments: Seem all round of join reuse the same hash join spill action and hash join spill helper, then what happens if a join is in non-spillable stage and it is informed to spill?
when will this if check be true?

> when will this if check be true?

When it's called by hash join v1
I think `BytesConsumed` should also be set to 0 if it is not 0 here?

> I think `BytesConsumed` should also be set to 0 if it is not 0 here?

If `BytesConsumed` is not 0, it means that there are bugs of managing memory usage in the codes.
Add check to make sure that `chk.Sel()` is nil?

> Add check to make sure that `chk.Sel()` is nil?

okk
Add some short path since if all the partition is spilled, no actual probe is needed?

> Add some short path since if all the partition is spilled, no actual probe is needed?

done
I think these two ways of writing are same.

> What does this mean?

Like aggregation executor, hash join spill can be triggered only when it's memory usage exceeds a threoshold.
I think you also need to reset `rowIndexInfos` if there is other conditon.

> I think you also need to reset `rowIndexInfos` if there is other conditon.

done

This optimization is suggested to be implemented before GA.
Too many small objects bring memory pressure, which might cause OOM during spilling.

> This optimization is suggested to be implemented before GA. Too many small objects bring memory pressure, which might cause OOM during spilling.

okk, I will create another pr to finish this.
